definitions.full: H5658. Abdon עַבְדּוֺן proper name I. proper name, masculine 1. a judge Judg 12:13 , 15 , ᵐ5 Αβδων , A ᵐ5 L Λαβδω ( μ ); (Ew compare בְּדָן 1Sam 12:11 , but read בָּרָק , see בְּדָן above). 2 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:23 , ᵐ5 Αβαδων , A ᵐ5 L Αβδων . 3 son of Jehiel a Gibeonite 1Chr 8:30 ; 9:36 ; ᵐ5 Αβαλων , Σαβαδων , A Αβδων , Σαβδων , ᵐ5 L Αβδων . 4 son of Micah 2Chr 34:20 , ᵐ5 Αβδοδομ , A ᵐ5 L Αβδων (= עַכְבּוֺר 2Kin 22:12 ). II. proper name, of a location Levitical city in Asher Josh 21:30 ; 1Chr 6:59 , ᵐ5 Δαββων , Αβαραν , A ᵐ5 L Αβδων (20 Manuscripts read עַבְדֹּן Josh 19:28 for עֶבְרֹן ), `Abde , Guérin Gal 2, 37 compare Buhl Geogr. 230 . עוֺבָל , I. עֵיבָל proper name, of a people Arabian people, descended from Joktan according to Gen 10:28 ( ᵐ5 L Γαιβαλ ); = עֵיבָל 1Chr 1:22 ( ᵐ5 L Ηβηλ ). On location compare Glaser Skizze ii. 426 . I. עֵיבָל see עוֺבָל above II. עֵיבָל proper name, masculine or of a people name in Edom , Gen 36:23 ( ᵐ5 Γαιβηλ ), = 1Chr 1:40 ( ᵐ5 Γαιβηλ ), A Γαοβηλ ᵐ5 L Ουβαλ ); according to Glaser Skizze ii. 426 possibly = foregoing (compare with name of (god) B¢l , Wkl Geschichte. Israel 120; Alttest. Unters. 117 f. ). III. עֵיבָל proper name, of a mountain Ebal , the mountain of cursing, north of Shechem (Nabulus), and opposite Mt. Gerizim (mountain of blessing, south of Shechem), Deut 11:29 , also Josh 8:30 , 33 (D); ᵐ5 Γαιβαλ (connection with above √ dubious; on בל = B¢l , compare Gray Prop. N. 124 n., and references ); — on Ebal see Rob BR ii. 275 ff. GASm Geogr. Ch. vi. Di Deut 11:29 Dr ib. Bd Pal. (1898), 257 . עבץ ( √ of following; meaning unknown).
